- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 0.67) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 1–3% for next 3–5 days.  
- When sentiment is strongly negative (≤ 0.33) or mixed, model often underestimates; adjust upward by 1–2% if recent price is falling.  
- After a sharp price spike (≥ 5% from prior peak), model frequently overshoots; cap forecast at +3% above peak for next 7 days.  
- If model forecast is consistently below true outcome over 3+ consecutive days, apply mean reversion: add 0.5–1.5% to forecast for next 5 days.  
- If sentiment history shows alternating bullish/bearish cycles, model tends to lag; shift forecast 1–2 days ahead if sentiment is trending.  
- For 30-day horizon, if true outcome is below 65% of historical 30-day average, reduce forecast by 2–4% to avoid overconfidence in downward trend.
